<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net46</TargetFramework>
    <AssemblyName>PeglinKoreanRevised</AssemblyName>
    <RootNamespace>PeglinKoreanRevised</RootNamespace>
    <Version>0.1.2</Version>
    <LangVersion>9.0</LangVersion>
    <Deterministic>true</Deterministic>
    <DebugType>none</DebugType>
    <RestorePackagesWithLockFile>true</RestorePackagesWithLockFile>
    <GenerateAssemblyInfo>true</GenerateAssemblyInfo>
    <PeglinManagedDir Condition="'$(PeglinManagedDir)' == ''"></PeglinManagedDir>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="BepInEx.Core" Version="5.4.21" ExcludeAssets="runtime" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.NETFramework.ReferenceAssemblies" Version="1.0.3" PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(PeglinManagedDir)' != ''">
    <Reference Include="Assembly-CSharp">
      <HintPath>$(PeglinManagedDir)/Assembly-CSharp.dll</HintPath>
      <Private>false</Private>
    </Reference>
    <Reference Include="UnityEngine">
      <HintPath>$(PeglinManagedDir)/UnityEngine.dll</HintPath>
      <Private>false</Private>
    </Reference>
    <Reference Include="UnityEngine.CoreModule">
      <HintPath>$(PeglinManagedDir)/UnityEngine.CoreModule.dll</HintPath>
      <Private>false</Private>
    </Reference>
    <Reference Include="Newtonsoft.Json">
      <HintPath>$(PeglinManagedDir)/Newtonsoft.Json.dll</HintPath>
      <Private>false</Private>
    </Reference>
    <Reference Include="netstandard">
      <HintPath>$(PeglinManagedDir)/netstandard.dll</HintPath>
      <Private>false</Private>
    </Reference>
  </ItemGroup>

  <Target Name="RequirePeglinManagedAssemblies" BeforeTargets="ResolveReferences">
    <Error Condition="'$(PeglinManagedDir)' == ''" Text="Set PeglinManagedDir to Peglin_Data/Managed before building." />
    <Error Condition="!Exists('$(PeglinManagedDir)/Assembly-CSharp.dll')" Text="Peglin Assembly-CSharp.dll was not found under PeglinManagedDir." />
    <Error Condition="!Exists('$(PeglinManagedDir)/Newtonsoft.Json.dll')" Text="Peglin Newtonsoft.Json.dll was not found under PeglinManagedDir." />
  </Target>
</Project>
